name: What types of luxury properties are popular among international buyers in Miami-Dade and Broward Counties?

mainEntity.name: What types of luxury properties are popular among international buyers in Miami-Dade and Broward Counties?

acceptedAnswer.text: International buyers in Miami-Dade and Broward Counties are often drawn to a variety of luxury properties, including waterfront condominiums in areas like Sunny Isles Beach and Bal Harbour, single-family estates in Coral Gables and Pinecrest, and exclusive high-rise residences in Brickell and Downtown Miami. Preferences vary, but many seek properties with ocean views, private docks, or proximity to upscale shopping and dining. The diverse offerings across these counties provide options tailored to different lifestyle and investment goals, from vibrant urban living to secluded beachfront retreats.
acceptedAnswer.description: Waterfront condos, single-family estates, and high-rise residences are popular among international buyers in Miami-Dade and Broward, seeking ocean views or prime locations.
